name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1490: The v1486 profile sigil fetched /api/status unguarded, so on file:// Chromium logged a Fetch API console error that .catch cannot suppress - Routine G 7/8 and the no-console-errors specs red. Every other same-origin call in the board already carried the protocol guard; the sigil skipped it. Off the console it now paints the local identity immediately instead of waiting 1.2s for an answer that was never coming. Also: two specs read localStorage raw where the app routes to the W world, so a CI runner (any non-Mac) failed a toggle that had worked.
